config.title: Swimming Lessons for Kids in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: When each swimming door opens for a Berlin child: Berliner Bäder courses, club waitlists, school swimming and the free holiday courses.

items.q: At what age can children start swimming lessons in Berlin?
items.a: The Berliner Bäder **Seepferdchen course starts at age 5**. Before that they run **parent-and-child courses** for ages 2 to 3 and 3 to 4, with 10 sessions of 30 minutes. Clubs and the DLRG have their own age rules, but their waitlists mean you should sign up years ahead.

items.q: How much does a Seepferdchen course cost in Berlin?
items.a: At the Berliner Bäder the basic course has **20 lessons of 45 minutes** and children aged 5 to 14 pay **EUR 10.50 a lesson including entry**, so **EUR 210**. The badge test is included. A 10-lesson follow-on course costs EUR 105.

items.q: Is there a waiting list for Berliner Bäder swimming courses?
items.a: No. The Berliner Bäder keep **no waitlists and take no pre-registration**. Each term goes on sale in the online shop: the January 2027 courses are planned to go on sale at the **end of November 2026**, with the course plan online in early November.

items.q: Are Berliner Bäder swimming lessons in English?
items.a: No. The course pages say lessons are held **in German only**. A child who knows a few pool words, such as springen, tauchen and ausatmen, follows the teacher much more easily.

items.q: When do children have swimming lessons at school in Berlin?
items.a: In **Year 3** of primary school. The standard the schools aim for is the **Bronze badge**, and the goal is that every child can swim safely by the end of primary school.

items.q: What are the free swimming courses in the Berlin school holidays?
items.a: Intensive courses run by the **Sportjugend Berlin** in the Easter, summer and autumn breaks, 45 minutes a day for about a week, in groups of up to 10. They are free for pupils in **Year 4 to 10** who have no Seepferdchen or Bronze after school swimming. Registration is on **schwimmkurse-sportjugend.de**, announced about four to six weeks before each break.
